bounded_practitioner_claim: For a fixed QRC, fixed temporal task, fixed readout, and finite feasible dissipator family, a task-resolved score plus task-conditional split-conformal calibration returns a variable-size candidate set with finite-sample marginal coverage of the empirical fully trained oracle for a new exchangeable reservoir realization.

scope.architecture: three-qubit XX+Z processor, continuous input map, 18 Pauli features
scope.candidate_family: 7 structurally normalized local-to-collective Kossakowski geometries; gamma_alpha is varied to match the local candidate's midpoint Liouvillian gap
scope.important_budget_boundary: the empirical seven-candidate comparison is gap-matched, not fixed-trace; the separate analytic Lindblad counterexample holds total damping fixed
scope.full_training_per_candidate: 1500 training and 1500 untouched test inputs after 500 washout steps
scope.coverage_assumption: reservoir realizations are exchangeable within each fixed task
scope.coverage_target: empirical oracle under the stated finite training/test protocol

fixed_nine_calibration_three_heldout.pooled_coverage_note: descriptive only; tasks sharing a Hamiltonian are not independent Bernoulli trials

all_balanced_nine_three_splits.note: resplits of the same twelve reservoir realizations; not independent experiments

deterministic_uniform_error_certificate.interpretation: valid but conservative; conformal calibration yields smaller adaptive sets
